title: Who is in the dark
hook: One in ten people on Earth still has no electricity.
notes: Access to electricity, % of population, ≈ 2022, World Bank / Tracking SDG7. Values rounded; countries not coloured are at or near universal access (≈ 95%+).

scenes.title: Light is not evenly spread
scenes.text: About 91% of humans have electricity at home. Of the roughly 700 million who don't, more than 80% live in sub-Saharan Africa.

scenes.title: The deepest darkness
scenes.text: In South Sudan, Chad and Burundi, roughly one person in ten has power at home. Across sub-Saharan Africa, it is about half.

scenes.title: A border you can see from space
scenes.text: At night, satellite images show South Korea glowing. North of the border, almost everything is dark apart from Pyongyang.
